visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: All-Negative Input Gives Zero
visualizerParams.problemDescription: For -4 -1 -8 the best subarray is just -1, but the program prints 0 for it.

solution.explanation: Starting best at 0 silently allows an empty subarray with sum 0, which beats every negative sum. A subarray must contain at least one element, so best starts from the first element.
